_comment: Cluster topology. Copy to /opt/tinyfaas/nodes.json on the controller
pi3 (192.168.0.115, relay 2bro channel 1, bricklet 26iw) is deliberately
excluded: it would not power down when told to and later would not wake,
and the cause was never established. Leave its relay channel open so it
stays off; it is not measured and not scheduled.
The leader is dispatch_only: it schedules and powers nodes but never runs
a function itself, so its draw is a constant rather than something that
Node ids match the SSH aliases and physical labels. The energy logger
channel is the channel ON THAT RELAY (0 or 1), not a cluster-wide index.
